title: The setup window ends at 'Cura is ready.' and never says how to turn real calls on
method: read of gui.py's finish screen against wizard.py's closing screen
observed_at_discovery: gui.py's finish() screen prints 'Cura is ready.' and offers exactly two buttons, 'Hear a practice call' and 'Close'. The string 'add-phone' does not occur anywhere in gui.py, nor does 'cura run'. wizard.py's closing screen prints both. Without add-phone the config has no twilio block and CuraVoice dials nobody; without cura run nothing is scheduled at all. install.sh advertises 'Cura's setup window' and the packaging targets open `cura setup --window`, so the advertised route ends with a caregiver told on screen that Cura is ready while no call will ever be placed. source_artifact is omitted because cura/setup/gui.py is untracked at HEAD and would book ERROR on every replay; commit gui.py and this case anchors properly. pytest exit 1, 1 failed 1 passed.
